item.name: Electric Guitar
item.difficultyNote: Easiest entry point because it uses two note lanes.
item.howToStart: Use the instrument in the Music Room, press G to open the song list, and choose a track.
item.multiplayerRole: Can be played alongside the other instruments in a synchronized group performance.
item.description: The two-lane guitar option in the Music Room. Current guides document F and J as its controls.
item.cardSummary: Electric Guitar uses two lanes in the Music Room, making it the simplest instrument for a first group performance.

item.name: Bass Guitar
item.difficultyNote: Four note lanes require more note coverage than Electric Guitar.
item.howToStart: Use the instrument in the Music Room, press G to open the song list, and choose a track.
item.multiplayerRole: Supplies the bass part in synchronized group performances.
item.description: A four-lane Music Room instrument for the bass part of a shared rhythm performance.
item.cardSummary: Bass Guitar supplies the four-lane bass part in a synchronized Music Room performance.

item.name: Drums
item.difficultyNote: Four note lanes make timing the main challenge.
item.howToStart: Use the instrument in the Music Room, press G to open the song list, and choose a track.
item.multiplayerRole: Supplies percussion in synchronized group performances.
item.description: A four-lane percussion instrument where timing matters most.
item.cardSummary: Drums provide the four-lane percussion part, with timing as the main focus.

item.name: Piano
item.difficultyNote: Four note lanes make keyboard timing the main challenge.
item.howToStart: Use the instrument in the Music Room, press G to open the song list, and choose a track.
item.multiplayerRole: Supplies the keyboard part in synchronized group performances.
item.description: A four-lane keyboard instrument for timing-based group performances.
item.cardSummary: Piano is a four-lane keyboard instrument for timing-based group performances in the Music Room.
